brief: Names the intermediate table of an SQL statement so that later code can read it, as a SQL WITH clause does.
detail: WITH(name).As(...) stores the current intermediate result under the name, as the rows and as the table. The SQL emulation is a set of functions on global state: CREATE_TABLE, INSERT_INTO, VALUES, SELECT, FROM_, WHERE_ and ORDER_BY. Only the registration is shown here, from an intermediate table set directly. See the warning of As for what is broken today.
